statement: ∀ (b : Module.Basis (Fin (l+1)) ℂ V), (∀ i, b i = LR.vec y v i.val) → ∀ i : Fin (l+1), LR.divided x (l-i.val) * LR.unit l b ⟨l, Nat.lt_succ_self l⟩ ⟨l, Nat.lt_succ_self l⟩ = LR.unit l b i ⟨l, Nat.lt_succ_self l⟩
proof:
classical
intro b hb i
have hx := h_T003.2.2.2.1
have hxt : LR.divided x (l-i.val) (LR.vec y v l) = LR.vec y v i.val := by
  rw [hx (l-i.val) l (le_refl l)]
  simp [Nat.sub_sub_self (Nat.le_of_lt_succ i.isLt)]
have hu (a j k : Fin (l+1)) : LR.unit l b a j (b k) = if k = j then b a else 0 := by
  simp [LR.unit, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_smul]
apply b.ext
intro k
rw [Module.End.mul_apply, hu, hu]
by_cases he : k = ⟨l, Nat.lt_succ_self l⟩
· simp only [he, if_true]
  rw [hb, hxt, hb]
· simp [he]
